title: Categories of left exact covering functors and left adjoints
statement: Let $C$ be a small category with a precoverage $K$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-precoverage] and let $E$ be a category, in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define $\operatorname{LexCov}(C,K;E)$ to be the full subcategory of functors $A:C\to E$ preserving finite limits and sending every finite $K$-covering family $(f_i:V_i\to U)$ to a jointly epimorphic family: for all $G$ and $b,c:A(U)\to G$, if $A(f_i)b=A(f_i)c$ for every $i$, then $b=c$. Empty families are allowed. For categories $D,E$, define the category of finite-limit-preserving left adjoints $D\to E$ to be the full subcategory of the functor category consisting of functors preserving finite limits and admitting a right adjoint. In both full subcategories, arrows are all natural transformations.
